**#2340 EPIC-NS-001 — Clean-break NMP app architecture migration** (p0, NS-M0)
The single overarching north-star epic. Drives elimination of `register_defaults()`, raw `open_interest`, old projection tiers, per-feature native ABI choices. Scope: typed read sessions, composable write door, explicit composition root, one UniFFI public surface for native (post-v1 gate #2125). The NS-M0 milestone still has this as its sole open issue; NS-M1 and NS-M3 closed cleanly. [...] - **#2340** — EPIC-NS-001 Clean-break NMP app architecture migration — Overarching violation epic: demands elimination of `register_defaults()`, raw `open_interest`/`ObservedProjection`/`ReducedSource`, platform-specific ABI choices, and compatibility shims; replaces them with explicit composition, typed read sessions, construction/signing/publishing separation, and one UniFFI native surface. All active slices trace back to this. [...] - **EPIC-NS-001 (#2340, p0)** — the clean-break architecture migration epic is still open and active; it is the governing tracker. [...] ### The one big thing in flight: the "clean-break" redesign (EPIC-NS-001, #2340, p0)
Everything active traces to one north-star epic. It's a coordinated three-door reform governed by ADR spine **0069–0073**, applied to native + browser + starter targets in lockstep, with doctrine-lint/doc ratchets locking each slice shut behind it ("ship the right thing, then lock the door"): [...] | **Whole refactor (EPIC-NS-001)** | "~100%" | **~70%** |
